Body.Content:
We are announcing Connector inventory in Power Platform inventory. This feature will reach general availability by November 10, 2026.

How does this affect me?
Connector inventory makes common admin workflows query-driven, identifying every resource affected by a deprecated connector, tracking Premium connector adoption for license decisions, scoping DLP policies to actual usage patterns, and reviewing a resource's full connector footprint during troubleshooting.

In the Power Platform admin center, a Connectors column appears across the inventory grids: the unified Manage > Inventory page and the resource-specific views under Copilot Studio, Power Apps, and Power Automate. The same data is available programmatically through the Power Platform for Admins V2 connector, the Power Platform inventory API, Power Platform CLI, and Azure Resource Graph, so you can build reports and automate governance.

What action do I need to take?
This message is for awareness, and no action is required.

If you would like more information on this feature, please visit Connector inventory Connector inventory.

Title: Power Platform admin center - Connector inventory in Power Platform inventory
